findings.failureScenario: LRCAT import commits the file additions (import::commit_prepared, one undo step) and then the metadata/album batch (a second step), and merges them by comparing s.undo.len() with undo0 captured at lightroom_job.rs:304. Session::commit drops the oldest entry once the history exceeds 1000 (lib.rs:516-519), so in a session whose undo history is already full (1000 steps from ordinary slider edits) undo.len() stays 1000 after both commits: merge_undo(0) is a no-op. The import is left as two undo steps; one Undo removes the ratings/edits/albums but keeps the added photos, a partial undo of an operation that is supposed to be one step.
findings.action: Capture s.commits() before the import and merge s.commits().wrapping_sub(before) steps (as sync.rs:633-639 does), instead of differencing undo.len().

findings.failureScenario: Photo ids are per library (library.rs:420, 512), and the desktop app switches libraries on the same Session (ui-egui panels/settings.rs switch_library: close_library then open_library). open_stores resets undo/redo/selection/source but not Session::before (HashMap<PhotoId, settings>) nor Session::previous_active. After using Before/After 'Set Before' on photo 12 in library A and switching to library B, photo 12 of B renders A's settings as its Before side, and beforeAfter.copyBeforeToAfter/swap commits those foreign settings onto B's photo 12. Likewise develop.pastePrevious in B copies settings from whatever B photo has A's previous-active id.
findings.action: In open_stores clear every photo-id-keyed session field when the catalog is replaced (before, previous_active, target_album, folder_changes, active_mask/active_spot), alongside the undo/redo reset.

findings.failureScenario: preview_job overwrites the key build_job made (which deliberately mixes in photo id and content: media.rs:1195-1197) with one from settings and size only. Two unedited photos from the same camera and aspect have identical develop settings, so hovering preset P on photo A and then stepping to photo B while still hovering P yields the same key. The UI's Renderer::request_needed (ui-egui render.rs:390-399) sees the Slot::Hover texture already holds that key and requests nothing, while the draw path filters that texture by photo (detail.rs:623): photo B never shows the hovered preset's look.
findings.action: Fold the photo id and content key into preview_job's key the same way build_job does (or XOR the settings change into job.key instead of replacing it).

findings.failureScenario: segment_poll treats 'pending counter is 0' as 'every reply has been sent', then clears segmenter.pending. The worker decrements the counter (drop(done)) before it sends the reply (worker.rs:277-278). If the UI frame polls in that window, idle is true, try_iter returns nothing, and pending is set to None; when the reply arrives next frame apply_outcome's Tag::Clicks branch sees pending != latest and returns, discarding the segmentation. The user's Object-mask click silently produces nothing and must be repeated.
findings.action: Decide idleness from the channel, not the counter: drain results first, then clear pending only if busy() is false and a second try_recv finds nothing; or send the reply before dropping the counter guard.
